description: Publish to one of the organization's connected social accounts (by channel id from neuron_list_social_channels). Text and/or up to 10 media items (several items make an Instagram carousel; X takes up to 4 images or 1 video). Set as='story' to publish one image or video as an Instagram story (Instagram accounts connected with Instagram login; stories don't show a caption). Media URLs must be publicly reachable; Instagram images must be JPEG. Browser channels (and method='browser') are queued: the result has status 'queued' and a taskId, and the post goes out when the user's browser with the Neuron extension picks it up. X posts over 280 characters fail rather than being cut.

method.description: Override how it posts; 'browser' queues it for the user's own logged-in tab (Instagram, X, LinkedIn). Default: the channel's own setting

name: neuron_post_to_social_channel
title: Post to Social Channel
